Observe: 2D ripple-tank view (SVG + Canvas 2D). Plane wavefronts of
wavelength λ hit a barrier at angle i; reflected wavefronts leave

arcs redraw. Experiment: 3 seeded target reflected-directions;
student sets i so reflected wavefronts propagate toward each.
Evaluate: reflected wavefronts hidden; only incident wave and
barrier; student submits i blind. Wrinkle: wave-theoretic version
(wavefronts, not rays) — distinct from geometric reflexion-lumiere.
